hooks.command: f="$HOME/.config/agent-manager/home"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then g="$(cat "$f")/am/guard.py"; else t="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; if [ -n "$t" ] && [ -z "$(git rev-parse --show-prefix 2>/dev/null)" ] && [ -f "$t/am/cli.py" ]; then in="$(cat)"; if printf "%s" "$in" | grep -Eq '"tool_name"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"Bash"' && printf "%s" "$in" | grep -Eq '"command"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"python3? -m am setup"[[:space:]]*[,}]'; then exit 0; fi; fi; echo "agent-manager: 가드 위치 기록(~/.config/agent-manager/home)이 없어 도구 실행을 막았습니다 — 매니저 레포 루트에서 python -m am setup 을 실행하세요" >&2; exit 2; fi; if python3 -c "import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 10))" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1; then p=python3; elif python -c "import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 10))" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1; then p=python; else echo "agent-manager: 실행 가능한 Python이 없어 가드를 실행할 수 없습니다" >&2; exit 2; fi; "$p" "$g" claude
